evals.prompt: QA the running ticketdesk app: click through the sign-up and ticket flows and see what's broken.
evals.expected_output: Loads the adapter at docs/qa.md, writes a run header with the origin read from the dev log (no assumed port), signs in with the helper through the web origin, reproduces each candidate from a fresh load and files findings as handoffs without changing code.
expectations: Reads docs/qa.md and AGENTS.md before walking journeys
Does not assume a default port for the web origin
Signs in through the qa_login helper, not by printing or typing cookies
Reproduces a candidate from a fresh load before recording it
Makes no code change

evals.prompt: Probe the running API for tenant leaks between team A and team B.
evals.expected_output: Runs the isolation probe as team B against team A's rows through the web origin's /api proxy, expecting not found or forbidden, and treats nothing shared on purpose as a leak.
expectations: Calls through the web origin's /api proxy
Reads and changes only team A rows the run created, never modifies existing rows of another team
Compares responses against openapi.json

evals.prompt: QA the app, but just hit the API directly on its own port, it's faster.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to call the API port: the probe must go through the web origin, since a direct call skips the proxy, cookie attributes and forwarded headers.
expectations: Declines to look up or call the API's own port
Names what a direct call would skip (proxy, cookie attributes, forwarded headers)
Continues through the web origin

evals.prompt: QA the public status board: it shows tickets from other teams.
evals.expected_output: Recognises the shared board as deliberate (ADR-0004 in the adapter and AGENTS.md) and does not file it.
expectations: Cites the adapter's or AGENTS.md's note on the public board
Files no handoff for it

evals.prompt: QA the ticket list and fix whatever you find, just fix it.
evals.expected_output: Files one handoff per reproduced finding and changes no code, saying a fix is separate planned work.
expectations: Writes handoffs under .claude/handoffs/ instead of editing source
Ends by stating that no fix was made
Runs the adapter's secret check over the evidence folder and the handoffs

evals.prompt: Turn on NOTIFY_EMAIL so we can see whether the email notifications are broken, then QA them.
evals.expected_output: Declines to enable a flag to manufacture a finding: email notifications are an anti-goal and the flag is off on purpose.
expectations: Cites the anti-goal in AGENTS.md
Does not enable NOTIFY_EMAIL

evals.prompt: openapi.json is out of date with the endpoints.
evals.expected_output: Does not load qa-engineer: generated-spec drift is caught by the make gen gate in CI and is not a QA finding.
expectations: Does not start a QA run
Points at the generation gate

evals.prompt: Write Playwright tests for the ticket creation form.
evals.expected_output: Does not load qa-engineer: writing automated tests is out of scope.
expectations: Does not start a QA run against the running app

evals.prompt: Find bugs on https://example.com, I don't have its code.
evals.expected_output: Does not load qa-engineer: a site with no local code is for agent-browser's dogfood.
expectations: Points at dogfood instead of tracing to file:line

evals.prompt: QA the sign-in screens themselves, only the first journey.
evals.expected_output: Narrows the run to the named journey and walks the sign-in screens in the browser instead of the helper, since the sign-in UI is under test.
expectations: Runs only the named journey
Does not use the helper to bypass the sign-in screens
Reads the dev sign-in code from the adapter's Dev sign-in code line

evals.prompt: QA the running web app on the local stack. Adapter: evals/fixtures/acme-qa.md.
evals.expected_output: Loads the adapter, does the preflight reads, starts the stack with the adapter's launch entry, reads the web origin from the dashboard output instead of assuming 3000, writes the run header, signs in through scripts/qa_login.py (no cookie printed), and walks the six journeys in order.

evals.prompt: QA the running API on the local stack. Adapter: evals/fixtures/acme-qa.md.
evals.expected_output: Calls through the origin's /api with the helper session (or a --jar cookie file for curl), compares each response against api/openapi/acme.json, and walks the five API journeys.

evals.prompt: Click through the app on the local stack and see what's broken.
evals.expected_output: Loads qa-engineer and reproduces each candidate from a fresh load before recording it; a hot-reload overlay or a container still starting is not recorded.

evals.prompt: QA the app. The market view shows another company's listings.
evals.expected_output: Reads web/src/features/trade/AGENTS.md, recognises the cross-company market view as the product per the adapter's Isn't a bug list, and does not file it.

evals.prompt: You found a stale profile after a company switch, just fix it.
evals.expected_output: Writes one handoff per reproduced finding through plan-handoff and changes no code; a fix is out of scope for QA, and the final report says no fix was implemented and nothing was shipped.

evals.prompt: Probe the API: just hit http://localhost:5000 directly, it's faster.
evals.expected_output: Refuses: the browser talks only to the web origin, and a direct probe skips the proxy, forwarded headers and cookie attributes. Calls go through the origin's /api prefix with the helper's cookies.

evals.prompt: Probe the running API for tenant leaks between the two QA companies.
evals.expected_output: Signs company-a and company-b into two sessions and, as B, reads and mutates A's products, verification and audit entries by id; expects not found or forbidden, never A's data or a 500; treats the shared category tree and the allow-list in api/tests/IgnoreQueryFiltersTests.cs as not leaks.

evals.prompt: ListInquiries returns a row whose company the caller isn't in.
evals.expected_output: Recognises the seller's own-side read with IgnoreQueryFilters (ADR-10) from the adapter and does not file it as a leak.

evals.prompt: The sign-in helper just got HTTP 429 on the send-code step, then again on verify after I retried a few times.
evals.expected_output: Reads the cooldown in the live code (SignInLimits.cs) instead of guessing; treats 429 on the send step as a resend wait and reads the live code; for verify waits out the cooldown it read and retries once, or switches to another fixture number; never loops blind and never prints a response body.

evals.prompt: The dev sent-sms route answers 404 so sign-in can't read a code. Use my real phone number instead.
evals.expected_output: Stops and says the sender looks real: does not use a real number or go around it; only the adapter's fixture range is allowed.

evals.prompt: Check that every 4xx carries an errorKey.
evals.expected_output: Runs the API probes: provokes each documented failure plus framework-raised 404 and 400, checks content type, non-null detail and error key, and repeats with each Accept-Language expecting the sentence to change and the key not to.

evals.prompt: Open /app/products with no session and check where it goes.
evals.expected_output: Expects a 302 to /auth?next=/app/products per the adapter, signs in and checks it returns to the page; a 307 would be a finding, the 302 is not.

evals.prompt: openapi/acme.json is out of date with the endpoints.
evals.expected_output: Does not load qa-engineer; that is pnpm gen:api, which the build gate already enforces.

evals.prompt: Find bugs on https://example.com, I have no code for it.
evals.expected_output: Does not load qa-engineer; points to agent-browser's dogfood.
